summary: Add bounded OpenAI-to-Google-Free answer-only provider fallback after terminal OpenAI cooldown/failure.
reason: The existing main fallback Sol-to-Luna stays inside OpenAI and therefore cannot recover from provider-wide OpenAI cooldown.

tests.name: provider-fallback-plugin
tests.evidence: test-provider-fallback.cjs passed recovery, no-tool-replay, zero-cost rejection, session tool-disable and attachment boundaries.

tests.name: gemini-wrapper
tests.evidence: test-gemini-request.py: 19 tests passed, including answer-only fallback without memory/capability retrieval.

capabilities.reason: No new user capability is introduced; this adds availability recovery to the existing conversational provider path.

architecture.reason: Adds bounded inter-provider coordination while reusing the existing mobile plugin, Gemini agent and wrapper; no new execution owner or persistent subsystem.

rollback: Revert the provider-fallback commit, rebuild/reinstall the previous mobile plugin and reload OpenClaw.
limitations: Fallback is answer-only and skips any turn that already called a tool.
Fallback currently covers direct allowlisted WhatsApp text turns on the main agent.
Attachments do not use provider fallback.
If Google Free Tier is unavailable or quota-exhausted, no paid fallback is attempted.
